service.method: SELECT USMT.USER_ID, USMT.PASSWORD, USMT.EMAIL FROM SUSMT USMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID}) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N'

SELECT USMT.USER_ID, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC, USMT.PASSWORD, USMT.EMAIL FROM SUSMT USMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 AND UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID}) AND UPPER(USMT.USER_NAME_LOC) = UPPER(${USER_NAME}) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N'

SELECT USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS USER_NAME, USMT.USER_ID, USMT.EMAIL, USMT.HOUSE_CODE, USMT.COMPANY_CODE FROM SUSMT USMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE UPPER(USMT.USER_NAME_LOC) = UPPER(${USER_NAME}) AND UPPER(USMT.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}

SELECT USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS USER_NAME, USMT.USER_ID, USMT.EMAIL, USMT.HOUSE_CODE, USMT.COMPANY_CODE FROM SUSMT USMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE UPPER(USMT.USER_ID) = UPPER(${USER_ID}) AND UPPER(USMT.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}

SELECT USMT.HOUSE_CODE, USMT.USER_ID, USMT.PASSWORD, USMT.EMAIL, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS USER_NAME FROM SUSMT USMT WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE 1=1 AND USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.USER_ID = ${USER_ID} AND UPPER(USMT.EMAIL) = UPPER(${EMAIL}) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N'
